decisions.reason: This control unit sits very close to the firm's existing airfield lighting and monitoring knowledge base, so under an absorptive-capacity logic management is likely to retain it and learn from early deployment rather than withdraw it quickly.

The surveillance display is related to the firm's airport systems capabilities but is somewhat more adjacent than core lighting control, so management would likely keep it while using customer feedback and internal know-how to refine it, though with a somewhat higher exit risk than Product A.
